retrievalProfile.description: An extreme close-up portrait featuring high-key, warm-toned lighting and a soft-focus finish that minimizes texture for an ethereal, dreamy appearance.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, cropped portrait focusing on the central features of a face (eyes, nose, lips) with a luminous, overexposed quality that blends skin tones into a seamless warm gradient. The composition is slightly off-center, creating an intimate and airy atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: The soft-focus eyes anchor the upper third of the frame
Warm peach and cream tones dominate the entire canvas
The lips provide a subtle focal point in the lower third
Minimalist typography is tucked into the lower corner to maintain facial focus

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is scaled to fill the entire frame, with the nose and lips positioned slightly right of center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes, though softened, act as the primary psychological anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top-left eye across the bridge of the nose down to the lips and finally to the small text in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The overexposed, bright areas of the skin act as functional negative space.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value (brightness), creating a washed-out, glowing effect.
paletteRestrictions: No cool blues or greens in the skin

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a fluid, organic script with varying stroke weights
Secondary text uses a wide-tracked, geometric sans-serif
Small scale relative to the image
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'f' has an elongated, elegant descender
Sans-serif characters are spaced extremely wide (letter-spacing)
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Organic script paired with rigid, wide-spaced geometric sans-serif for a modern-classic contrast.

preserve: Wide tracking of the secondary text
Lowercase script for the primary name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, handwritten feel of the primary name
Provides the clean, geometric base for the secondary name

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme close-up of a face with warm, high-key lighting and a heavy soft-focus filter. The skin should appear luminous and peach-toned with minimal visible pores. Crop tightly on the eyes, nose, and lips.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small, elegant script name in muted gold in the bottom left corner. Directly beneath it, place a second name in a small, wide-tracked blue-grey sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-key and warm?
Is the focus soft enough to blur skin texture?
Is the typography small and positioned in the bottom left?
Is the crop an extreme close-up of the face?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the secondary text
mustRedesign: Do not use high-contrast black text
postGenerationChecks: Confirm skin tones are peach/cream rather than yellow/orange
Ensure the script text is legible but delicate
Verify the extreme crop maintains facial recognition
Check that the soft focus doesn't obscure the eyes entirely
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme Close-up + Soft Focus + High-Key Warmth + Minimalist Corner Typography
